result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main defect is a promotional badge on the pizza card that reads "-0%", which is a nonsensical discount. There are also a few minor polish and accessibility concerns.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card reads "-0%". A zero-percent discount is meaningless and looks like a data or template bug. It misleads users and undermines trust in promotions.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0, or show the correct discount value. Add validation so that only discounts greater than 0 are rendered.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (delivery fees under the carousel cards, the search placeholder, and the inactive tab labels) has low contrast against the light backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the gray text to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1).

issues.description: The time pills (for example "15–25 min") sit on busy images. The pill on the first card overlaps the plate image and is crowded against the card's left edge. The heart icon on the pizza card has a low-contrast dark translucent circle on the dark wood background.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent padding and a stronger contrasting background to the overlay chips and the favorite button.

issues.description: The €0 delivery badge on the ramen card and the promotional banner both use a similar green, and the banner's decorative circles cut awkwardly at the bottom right corner. The illustrations look like placeholder art rather than real restaurant photos.
issues.suggestion: Clean up the decorative shapes, and replace the placeholder illustrations with real restaurant imagery.
